title: Literature
tagline: Epic, drama, poetry and the novel from Homer to Toni Morrison
hero_file: Gustave Doré - Dante Alighieri - Inferno - Plate 9 (Canto III - Charon).jpg
hero_caption: Gustave Doré, Charon ferrying souls across the Acheron, illustration for Dante's Inferno, 1857–67
intro: Western literature from the Homeric epics to the late twentieth century, told through its authors and their key works: epic and lyric poetry, tragedy and comedy, romance, the essay, the novel and the short story. Every author has a full biography and every work an introduction to its story, context and influence. Pictures are manuscripts, first-edition title pages and early illustrations from Wikimedia Commons; portraits are paintings, drawings, engravings or sculpture only, and books still in copyright are not reproduced.
